gmailCleanup.title: Clean up Gmail Sent
gmailCleanup.subtitle: Move matching messages from the connected Gmail Sent folder to Trash. App notification history will not be changed.
gmailCleanup.trashWarning: Messages moved to Trash can usually be recovered for 30 days, after which Gmail automatically deletes them. Review the message count and account carefully before continuing.
gmailCleanup.permissionRequired: Connected as {{email}}. Grant the additional Gmail mailbox-management permission to continue.
gmailCleanup.accountNotConnected: Connect your Gmail account to preview and clean up sent messages.
gmailCleanup.permissionMissing: Gmail mailbox-management permission was not granted. Reconnect and allow the requested permission.
gmailCleanup.sourceApp: Only messages sent by this app
gmailCleanup.appOnlyCoverage: New app messages are indexed automatically. Older app messages are included only when an existing delivery log saved their Gmail message ID; messages without a recorded ID are intentionally excluded.
gmailCleanup.confirmTrashDetails: You are about to move {{count}} message(s) from {{email}} to Gmail Trash. Scope: {{source}}. Period: {{period}}. {{window}}
gmailCleanup.confirmTrashInputHelp: You can recover messages from Gmail Trash before Gmail automatically deletes them.
gmailCleanup.trashPartial: Moved {{trashed}} message(s) to Trash; {{failed}} could not be moved. Preview again to review what remains.
gmailCleanup.auditWarning: Messages were moved to Trash, but the audit record could not be updated. Contact an administrator.
